title: Bark Fart Mace
description: this texture pack adds the meme bark fart when u mace somebody, made by henrikuzas
body:
Replaces the default Wind Burst I–III Mace sound effects with the iconic Bark Fart meme sound. Every time Wind Burst activates, you’ll hear the legendary bark fart audio instead of the normal effect, turning launches and combat into complete chaos.

Features:

Replaces Wind Burst I, II, and III Mace activation sounds
Uses the iconic Bark Fart meme sound effect
Lightweight texture/sound pack
Multiplayer friendly (client-side resource pack)

Created by henrikuzas (Discord).

Install the pack, enable it in Resource Packs, grab a Mace with Wind Burst, and enjoy the noise.
